facts.business: Mauria Udyog Limited is engaged in manufacturing and exporting welded steel LPG cylinders, valves, regulators, disposable cylinders, methyl bromide cylinders, refillable cylinders, and terry towels.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management is hopeful of higher turnover during next year 2026-27

key_risks: Escalation of geopolitical conflicts in 2025 may lead to supply dislocations, higher commodity prices, reviving inflationary pressures and stalling monetary policy easing
